context: OpenStax calculus: finite two-sided real derivative on an open interval
display_term: derivative of a real function at an interior point

formulations.text: Let f:I→R be a function on an open real interval I containing a∈I. If the finite limit exists, the derivative of f at a is f′(a)=lim_{h→0}(f(a+h)−f(a))/h, where h≠0 and a+h∈I.

context: OpenStax elementary real algebra: piecewise absolute-value function
display_term: absolute value of a real number

formulations.text: For each real number x, its absolute value |x| is x if x≥0 and −x if x<0. Consequently |x|≥0 and for real a,b the quantity |a−b| is their usual distance on the real line.
